metrics.name: quality
metrics.bias: Verifier labels come mostly from seeded corpora, which measure catches-what-we-plant and can flatter; producer quality rides same-family judges (self-preference, correlated errors) and is trusted only alongside a valid calibration certificate.

metrics.name: consistency
metrics.bias: Stability is not correctness — a subject that is consistently wrong scores as stable; k per case is small, so unanimity over k runs is a weak sample of the output distribution.

metrics.name: adherence
metrics.bias: Mechanical shape checks only — a well-formed deliverable can still be wrong, and scope/read-only compliance beyond deliverable shape is not yet captured in run records.

metrics.name: grounding
metrics.bias: Judge-checked by a same-family judge (self-preference, correlated errors) — evidence-existence is checkable but conclusion-follows is judgment, so grounding verdicts gate nothing without a valid calibration certificate.
